Write the author merges to a review sheet

Source: R/authors_clean.R
review_sheet.saqr_authors.Rd

Writes every merge [authors_clean()] made (one Scopus ID with several spellings, Scopus IDs joined by ORCID, people with two ORCIDs) to a file, the ones whose names do not look alike (`check = TRUE`) first. Write `split` in `decision` for a merge that is wrong; leave it empty (or write `keep`) for one that is right. Then pass the file back: `authors_clean(..., review = file)`.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'saqr_authors'
review_sheet(x, file)

Arguments

x

An [authors_clean()] result.

file

The file to write, `.csv` (UTF-8) or `.xlsx`. An existing file is never replaced, since it may hold your decisions.

Value

The file path, invisibly. The sheet has one row per merged person: `decision` (empty), `check`, `name`, `spellings`, `papers`, `scopus_ids`, `orcid_conflict`, `merged` and `person_key`.

Errors

Raises `saqrmisc_bad_input` when `file` is not `.csv` or `.xlsx` or already exists; `saqrmisc_missing_package` for `.xlsx` without writexl.

See also

[authors_clean()]

Examples

scopus_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".csv")
utils::write.csv(data.frame(
  Authors = c("Endrass B.", "Lugrin B."), `Author(s) ID` = c("7;", "7;"),
  DOI = c("10.1/a", "10.1/b"), EID = c("2-s2.0-1", "2-s2.0-2"),
  check.names = FALSE
), scopus_file, row.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8")
papers <- data.frame(eid = c("2-s2.0-1", "2-s2.0-2"), AU = c("ENDRASS B", "LUGRIN B"),
                     DI = c("10.1/a", "10.1/b"), PY = c(2012, 2016))
sheet <- tempfile(fileext = ".csv")
review_sheet(authors_clean(papers, scopus = scopus_file, openalex = FALSE), sheet)
#> file21ed4c83dadd.csv: 1 merge(s), 1 to check. Write split in decision for a wrong one, then authors_clean(review = "file21ed4c83dadd.csv").
utils::read.csv(sheet)
#>   decision check     name            spellings papers scopus_ids orcid_conflict
#> 1       NA  TRUE LUGRIN B ENDRASS B | LUGRIN B      2          1          FALSE
#>   merged person_key
#> 1   TRUE   scopus:7
